build_transformer_sentence_encoder: build a bidirectional transformer sentence encoder for BERT style models with token and segment embeddings
create_bert_param_init: create a function to initialize BERT model weights using normal distribution for linear and embedding layers
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the transformer encoder to get inner states and sentence representations
build_encoder_layer: build a transformer sentence encoder layer with configurable attention heads and feed-forward dimensions
freeze_embeddings: freeze embedding parameters and transformer layers for transfer learning with the encoder model
